services.name: Café Scuba
services.desc: In partnership with the Aquarium of the Pacific, SAVOR serves environmentally friendly and sustainable seafood certified by the Marine Stewardship Council at our main dining room, Café Scuba. Café Scuba is a relaxed atmosphere overlooking our Seal and Sea Lion exhibit and is the perfect place to grab a meal or a quick snack. Read this local review. Menu is subject to change. The Aquarium of the Pacific does not allow outside food in the Aquarium. However, guests may use the picnic bench area to enjoy outside food. Aquarium of the Pacific and its in-house caterer SAVOR are offering a new daily café menu to include an expansive range of chef-created plant-based food and sustainable seafood
